name: Mosca
fix_description: In withdrawAll, zero out user.balance, user.balanceUSDT, and user.balanceUSDC after transferring funds. Currently the function transfers the full balance but never resets the state, allowing repeated withdrawals of the same amount.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is very short and the exploit flow is straightforward: join, take a flash loan, call buy, exit, then repeat join/exit in a simple loop to extract value. It involves only one protocol plus a standard flash loan callback, with no complex pricing math, cross-protocol state reasoning, or deep protocol internals required.
